versions.short: The bill would direct the Department of Agriculture and the Department of the Interior to seek to finish the Continental Divide National Scenic Trail within 10 years of the bill becoming law. It would create a joint Forest Service and Bureau of Land Management team to help complete and improve the trail. The Department of Agriculture would also have to finish a comprehensive development plan for the trail within three years. Finally, the two departments would seek agreements with volunteer and nonprofit groups to help complete and manage the trail.
